sloka: सुतस्य यदि मे भार्या ततस्त्वं हि स्नुषा भवेः ।बाढमित्येव सा रम्भा प्राह रावणमुत्तरम् ।। ७.२६.३२ ॥
transliteration: sutasya yadi me bhāryā tatastvaṁ hi snuṣā bhaveḥ ।bāḍhamityeva sā rambhā prāha rāvaṇamuttaram ।। 7.26.32 ॥

translations.english: Rambha replied to Ravana, saying, "If I were the wife of your son, then you would indeed be my father-in-law."
